title: authentication.jwt config
description: Appears as blueprint.components[].config. The Selector fills it from blueprint values.

jwtSecretEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the signing secret (at least 32 bytes). Maps to mortar.auth.jwt.secret.

ttlMinutes.description: Token lifetime in minutes. Maps to mortar.auth.jwt.ttl-minutes.

issuer.description: iss claim. Tokens from another issuer are rejected. The Selector defaults it to the blueprint's metadata.name.

allowedOrigins.description: Browser origins allowed by CORS for /api/**. Maps to mortar.auth.jwt.allowed-origins.
